title: Joomla records a push created meet the copy's own assets on the next sync: no false asset_id conflicts
steps: Run the real MariaDB merge case of pushed articles with assets numbered the other way round, and the seed case.
expect: No asset_id conflict; each live asset maps to the copy's asset of the same article.
The id map holds only asset ids the copy has; a created article's seed names its asset.

tests: Joomla: the assets of articles a push created meet the copy’s own assets, never a false conflict or an id the copy lacks (#172)
Joomla: an article the push creates seeds its asset to be aligned by name, so the next sync meets the copy’s own (#172)
